title: Aromatic Flaky Argentinian Pepper Skewers
description: Floral, flaky skewers featuring sashimi-cut red pepper, seasoned with Argentine herbs, cooked on a hot stone plate for a crowd-pleaser whole30 dish.
instructions: Preheat a hot stone plate over medium-high heat until steaming hot.
In a bowl, toss the pepper and onion pieces with olive oil, oregano, rosemary, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper until evenly coated.
Skewer alternating pepper and onion slices onto 8-inch skewers.
Place the skewers on the hot stone plate and sear for 3 minutes on one side.
Flip the skewers and sear for another 3 minutes, until the peppers are charred and tender.
Transfer the skewers to a serving plate and sprinkle with lemon zest.
Serve immediately while the stone plate is still hot.
